issues.description: The UML fragment in problem_statement.md declares Stock.add(String) to return void, but both the template and the solution implement Stock.add(String) to return int. This mismatch between the problem statement's UML and the provided code can confuse students about the intended method signature and return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare add(String): int (matching the template and solution), or alternatively change the template and solution implementation to return void and adjust usage accordingly. Prefer updating the UML to match the existing code (add returns int) since code and solution already rely on the integer return value.
